title: Second and third storey walls: maximum 14 m length at the Table 3.4a setback
text: C3.4.2 The second and third storey of walls shall be set back in accordance with Table 3.4a for a maximum wall length of 14m (including any balconies). For a portion of wall exceeding 14m in length: i. the wall is to be set back 3m from the lot boundary for the remainder of its length; or ii. contain a minimum 3m x 3m separation measured from the lot boundary (Refer Figure 3.4e).

parts.label: upper storey wall not longer than 14 m
portion beyond 14 m set back 3 m

replaces.note: second-storey 14 m rule extended to second and third storeys (C4P1-090)
new for R10-R25 (no length-based rule in Part B)

notes: from: ch3 C3.4.2. Applies to buildings of two or more storeys; the first 14 m is tested by the C3.4.1 side rules. With the third storey at 2.0 m (Table 3.4a) the 14 m rule bites on long three-storey apartment walls (C4P1-090). Overlaps the R50-R60 14 m boundary wall rule.
